title: Total influence of tribes
statement: Let $w$ and $s$ be positive integers, and form the tribes function on $s$ blocks of $w$ signs each, taking the disjunction of the conjunctions on those blocks. Its total influence is $sw\,2^{-(w-1)}(1-2^{-w})^{s-1}$.
